messages:
ant: quick follow-up to the lease allocator rfc - hit a rollback where eviction and lease-renew overlapped in staging, small-batch workload.
sel: saw a similar flake earlier. can you paste logs?
ant: logs:
[evict] lease=900 renew@1769999998 -> rollback
[kv] slot=42 still referenced
[compact] removed slot=42
sel: looks ordering-related, notify may be delayed.
jia: current flow is allocate -> persist lease -> async notify compactor. if notify lags compactor can reclaim.
tom: options: 1) make persist+notify sync (adds latency), 2) monotonic lease-gen + CAS on metadata so evict verifies gen, 3) compactor consults authoritative lease table before reclaim (extra rpc).
ant: prefer (2) as middle ground. renew bumps gen, write with cas; evict compares gen and aborts if mismatch.
sel: requires CAS/compare support in metadata store. dedicated/providers likely ok; hosted may need shim.
jia: tradeoffs: extra metadata ops and cas retries vs correctness. we can accept spurious aborts with backoff. add telemetry.
tom: i'll prototype cas path in allocator branch and add a microbench for renew+evict contention.
ant: add counters: lease_reclaim_abort, lease_cas_fail, lease_double_ref_detect.
ops-bot: feature-flag lease_metrics_v1 toggled ON in staging.
sel: i'll add a unit test that injects renew delay to force the race.
jia: i'll audit metadata providers for cas and open an issue linking rfc #421 w/ perf targets: p99 latency increase <1ms, abort <0.1% under normal load.
ant: consider batching gen increments per-tenant to reduce qps; must keep monotonic ordering. keep sync persist as fallback.
tom: action items: tom -> prototype+bench; sel -> telemetry+tests; jia -> provider audit+issue; ant -> update rfc + metrics. check-in friday.
ant: thanks all :thumbsup:
